name: extract-utm
description:
The value of a UTM tag of the URL, URL-decoded.

«?utm_source=%D0%AF%D0%BD%D0%B4%D0%B5%D0%BA%D1%81» → «Яндекс», «+» as a space. Only the part before «#» is searched; the name counts in any case; the first tag of that name wins; no such tag gives an empty cell.

tag: the name of the tag without utm_: source, medium, campaign, term or content.

Example: semkit read --text "https://site.ru/?utm_source=ya&utm_medium=cpc&id=5" extract-utm medium write -
-> cpc

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --tag
options.description: the name of the tag without utm_: source, medium, campaign, term or content.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: TAG
arguments.description: the name of the tag without utm_: source, medium, campaign, term or content. The same as --tag TAG.
